about:
We aim to be the single most reliable partner in the acceleration of the growth of our partners, customers and Rocketeers.

And our promise is to help Rocketeers learn and grow so that they can have an impact on their careers, their families and communities.

We're self funded, and wholly owned by our Rocketeers. As well being able to own part of the company. All Rocketeers also share in the profits that we make. We all grow the tree 🌳 and we all share the fruit 🍇.

We're diverse, have an athletic mindset and support causes unique to each of us. We believe that empathy, story and learning about each other drives a strong culture and allows us to be part of a family. Yes, we're a family and we are also accountable to each other - it's not common. 

The world already has enough companies that are just driving to make money from screwing customers and the promise of the big exit. We attract those who demand more deeper connections and meaning out of the time that they invest in their time at work.

Let's chat if you want to learn more.
